title: A guide inside the Studio
changes: A tutorial at /tutorial, in the sidebar beside the organisation's kits: twelve chapters in Hebrew that follow one family — the Helfgotts — from connecting a folder through to a finished presentation.
Every stage is shown with a mock of the screen it describes, drawn from the app's own colours and layout rather than captured as a picture, so the guide cannot drift out of step with the interface.
Issue reporting is chapter 11, so there is one place to send someone rather than two.
